= .github

Workflows, community-health files, CODEOWNERS.

**No `README.adoc` in this directory on purpose.** GitHub's repository
front page prefers a README in `.github/` over the repository root
(then `docs/`). A layer README here stole the homepage from
`/README.adoc`. Layer notes live in this `DIRECTORY.adoc` instead.
